source.source_title: Henry Ford's Mirror of America (Part I)
source.why_this_clip: A huge elephant-shaped building fills the frame in three-quarter view facing left, with trunk, tusk, ear and front legs visible; it does not move and the camera only drifts slightly. The interval ends at 4.5 s because the shot cuts to the sea at 4.75 s, and nothing later in the clip shows an elephant.
